classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the marked angles as exterior and subtract each from 180 for four vertices; routine.

content.prompt: Work out the sizes of the interior angles at A, B, C and D.

answer.worked:
Each interior angle and its exterior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=180^{\circ}-75^{\circ}=105^{\circ}\\B&=180^{\circ}-80^{\circ}=100^{\circ}\\C&=180^{\circ}-95^{\circ}=85^{\circ}\\D&=180^{\circ}-110^{\circ}=70^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$
